title: Decor
note: Decor pack (tools/make_decor_assets.py): curtains and drapes that mount on an inside wall, and house plants for the floor (one hangs from the ceiling). The size comes from the universal _base_dimensions schema.

decor_kind.label: Piece
decor_kind.note: Which piece: curtains, drapes, fig, palm, snake, monstera, succulent or hanging_fern.

style.label: Style
style.note: Classic (brass rod, rings, valance; tapered pot) or modern (black rail, ceiling track; drum planter).

color.label: Fabric colour
color.note: The fabric (curtains, drapes): burgundy, forest, navy, camel (classic) or charcoal, stone, teal, mustard (modern); or the pot (plants): terracotta, ivory, cobalt, charcoal (classic) or white, black, concrete, sage (modern).

mount.label: Mount
mount.note: Mounts on an inside wall (the click sets the bottom hem), stands on the floor (placed), or hangs from a ceiling.
